reason: A MEASUREMENT, NOT A GATE — the gate is per ROW and lives in app.js, which compares shareClassToken(filed name) against the sourced asset's `cls`. This file lists the tickers where at least one published row's filing states a class the symbol is not, so the class can be read and the resolver fixed; nothing reads it to decide what to publish. Withholding these tickers WHOLESALE was the first design and it cost 182,106 correctly-filed rows to protect 6,190.
